stem:
The diagram shows Anika's battery pack connected to a charger plug. After charging, she uses the same pack in her toy car many times, then charges it again.

Which claim about this battery is correct?

options.text: It is rechargeable because it can be charged again and reused many times.
It is rechargeable because it ran the toy several times before going flat, even with no charging.
It is single-use because any battery that powers a toy must be thrown away after one day.
It is single-use because the diagram shows wires, so charging cannot restore it.

teacher.key_rationale: A rechargeable battery is one that can be charged again and reused many times. Running until flat without charging does not meet that test.
teacher.figure_note: Battery pack joined by leads to a labelled charger and plug.
